info.title: 3Common API
info.description: Public REST API for the 3Common event management platform.

get.description: Lists the organizer's events, optionally filtered by status or searched by name/address. Sorted by start date descending. Paginated.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status; omit to include all

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search events by name or address (case-insensitive partial match)

parameters.name: startBefore
parameters.description: Only events starting on or before this date (ISO 8601). Example: 2025-06-01T00:00:00.000Z

parameters.name: startAfter
parameters.description: Only events starting on or after this date (ISO 8601). Example: 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
JSON-encoded array of filter groups for advanced filtering.
Each group has "logic" ("and" | "or") and "conditions" (array of conditions or nested groups).
Each condition has "field", "operator", and optional "value".
Operators by type:
- Text: is_equal_to_any_of, is_not_equal_to_any_of, contains, contains_exactly
- Date: is_before, is_after, is_between (value: {start, end})
- Number: is_equal_to, is_not_equal_to, is_greater_than, is_greater_than_or_equal_to, is_less_than, is_less_than_or_equal_to, is_between
- Select: is_any_of, is_none_of
- Common: is_empty, is_not_empty
Example: [{"logic":"and","conditions":[{"field":"status","operator":"is_any_of","value":["open","closed"]},{"field":"ticketSum","operator":"is_greater_than","value":10}]}]

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Valid: id, name, type, schedule, start, end, multiDayStartTimes, multiDayEndTimes, status, itemsSold, revenueCents, minPriceCents, maxPriceCents, currency, timeZone, isPublic, isVirtual, location, locationPlaceholder, virtualEventLink, venueName, image, images, tags, customTags, isCancelled, createdAt, updatedAt. Omit for all fields.

description.description: Event description as HTML. Only present when descriptionBlocks is empty.

descriptionBlocks.description:
Rich content blocks for the event description. If present and non-empty, clients should render these instead of the description field.
Each block has a type (text: HTML content, image: URL, video: YouTube URL) and content string.

start.description: For single-date events the start time; for multi-date the first time slot.

end.description: For single-date events the end time; for multi-date the last time slot.

multiDayStartTimes.description: All start times for multi-day events

multiDayEndTimes.description: All end times for multi-day events

status.description:
The status of an event.
- draft: has not been published
- open: published and ticket sales are open
- closed: published, ticket sales are closed but the event will proceed as normal
- unpublished: was previously published, but is no longer visible
- cancelled: published, ticket sales closed, event is cancelled
- postponed: published, ticket sales closed, event is postponed
- schedule: not yet published, scheduled to be published in the future

minPriceCents.description: Minimum ticket/product price in cents. Does not contain fees.

maxPriceCents.description: Maximum ticket/product price in cents. Does not contain fees.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone (may be missing for pre-2024 events)

isPublic.description: True if the event is public

isVirtual.description: True if the event is virtual

location.description: Event location with address and coordinates

locationPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text to link to location

venueName.description: Name of the associated seating-chart venue

image.description: URL of the event's main image

get.description: Returns the payout balance (available / pending / instant, plus paid-out when scoped to an event), grouped by currency. Money is in cents.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Scope the balance to one event; omit for account-wide

balance.description: Net available to the host, in cents.

net.description: Gross minus fees minus refunds, in cents.

currency.description: Currency code; null on an empty bucket.
